dyakuPatientsDescription: Query patients from MINSA's Dyaku FHIR system
dyakuPatientsSearchTitle: Search Results - Dyaku MINSA FHIR Patients
dyakuPatientsSubtitle: List of patients registered in MINSA's FHIR system
errorLoadingPatients: Patients could not be retrieved. Try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
syncDescription: This process will synchronize up to {{batchSize}} patients from Dyaku FHIR system to OpenMRS.
syncErrorMessage: Error during synchronization. See details below.
syncWarning: Existing patients will be updated, and new ones will be created automatically.
syncDuplicateInBatch: Import blocked: this identity is repeated in the batch or is already being processed. Review the source records.
syncIdentityAmbiguous: Import blocked: the local identity could not be matched uniquely by DNI and document type. Review the existing records.
syncIdentityInvalid: Import blocked: a single explicit, unchanged eight-digit DNI and an active patient are required. Review the source record.
syncImportFailed: The patient import could not be completed. Review the local record and contact support before trying again.
syncLocalLookupFailed: Import blocked: the local identity search could not be completed. Check your connection and access before trying again.
syncMetadataInvalid: Import blocked: identifier or location metadata could not be verified. Contact support.
syncPatientDataInvalid: Import blocked: the source demographics are incomplete or invalid. Review the name, birth date and gender.
syncRemoteResponseInvalid: The source patient response could not be verified. No import was started. Contact support.
syncWriteUnconfirmed: The patient save could not be confirmed. Review the local record before trying again.
